methodology.price_formula: For every market: p_i = 1/decimal_i; q_i = p_i / sum(p) removes the displayed overround; c_i = win_tips_i / sum(win_tips) is the OLBG consensus; w = 0.28 * total_tips/(total_tips+8); fair_i ∝ (1-w)q_i + w*c_i (+ a small official-strength tilt on two-sided result markets). fair_i converts to an American price.
methodology.confidence: High: edge >= 1.5 pp, >= 3 market tips, >= 55% consensus, and an official event/competition link, official form/statistic, or selection-specific official ranking. Medium: edge >= 0.8 pp with >= 2 tips or official support. Low: otherwise. All published picks must display between -250 and +10000.
methodology.limitations: OLBG publishes tipped events, not a complete fixture database. Displayed prices are OLBG quotes at snapshot time, not live bookmaker offers. Official injury sheets were not published in the captured sources; those fields stay blank and are flagged. Our fair price is a transparent research line, not a guarantee or a prediction of outcome certainty.
